summary: Part 3 of the "6.0 Returns (Seller)" training (12:12 to 12:26) shows one page, "Revibe Return Process", a one-page PDF (Revibe-Return-Process.pdf) in a PDF viewer. The page sets out the end-to-end return workflow: four steps (customer claim, Revibe agent check, pickup, seller action), the eligibility window of 15 days from delivery, the VALID and INVALID paths with dispute resolution through proof, Revibe review and Lab verification, and the portal info and payment locations. The trainer's narration in this window is limited: the pack holds only the fragment 'will keep the device.' at 12:16 and the closing remarks at 12:17 to 12:24. The speech at 12:10 that starts that sentence runs into this window. The walkthrough is therefore taken mainly from the screen. Two frames were opened, and the same page remains on screen to the end of the video.

facts.statement: Return claims: eligibility is 15 days from delivery.

evidence.quote: Eligibility box: 'Eligibility: 15 days from delivery · any second valid claim on the same order is accepted even after 15 days.'

facts.statement: A second valid claim on the same order is accepted even after 15 days.

evidence.quote: 'any second valid claim on the same order is accepted even after 15 days.'

facts.statement: Step 1, Customer raise claim: the customer raises a return through the 'My Account' section on Revibe. The status is Pending (Revibe team to review). No action is required from the seller.

evidence.quote: Step 1 'Customer raise claim' tagged 'NO ACTION REQUIRED': 'The customer raises a return through the "My Account" section on Revibe. Status: Pending (Revibe team to review)'.

facts.statement: Step 2, Revibe Agent Check: the Revibe agent reviews the customer's proof. Once validated, the request is marked Completed. The status shown is Pending Collection. No action is required from the seller.

evidence.quote: Step 2 'Revibe Agent Check' tagged 'NO ACTION REQUIRED': 'The Revibe agent reviews the customer's proof. Once validated the request is marked Completed. Status: Pending Collection'.

facts.statement: Step 3, Pickup, for AE and ZA: the AWB is auto-created and the claim moves to Under Collection immediately.

evidence.quote: Step 3 'Pickup' tagged 'ACTION REQUIRED IF SA': 'AE & ZA: AWB auto-created — moves to Under Collection immediately'.

facts.statement: Step 3, Pickup, for SA: the seller must create the AWB manually.

evidence.quote: 'SA: Seller to create the AWB manually'.

facts.statement: Step 4, Seller action: once the Courier Company delivers, the seller can see the claim, and its status becomes Under QC.

evidence.quote: Step 4 'Seller action' tagged 'ACTION REQUIRED': 'Once the Courier Company delivers the seller can see the claim which status become Under QC'.

facts.statement: At seller action the seller has two options: mark the claim VALID or mark it INVALID.

evidence.quote: 'Two options: Mark VALID / Mark INVALID'.

facts.statement: A claim marked VALID gives an Instant Refund: the customer is refunded immediately and the case is closed.

evidence.quote: VALID box 'Instant Refund': 'The customer is refunded immediately Case closed.'

facts.statement: A claim marked INVALID goes through dispute resolution in this order: Proof Required, then Revibe Review, then Lab Verification.

evidence.quote: INVALID box: 'Proof Required → Revibe Review → Lab Verification'.

facts.statement: For an INVALID claim, the seller submits proof: a written message plus supporting proof to challenge the customer claim is required.

evidence.quote: 'Seller submits proof: Required: written message + supporting proof to challenge the customer claim.'

facts.statement: Revibe checks the proof: if the proof is good, the device is sent to the Lab; if the proof is insufficient, the seller is asked for new proof and re-marks the claim Valid or Invalid.

evidence.quote: 'Revibe checks proof: Good proof → device sent to Lab. Insufficient → seller asked for new proof and re-marks Valid/Invalid.'

facts.statement: Revibe Lab final decision: if Valid, the customer gets a full refund and the device is shipped back to the seller. If Invalid, the customer pays and the device is shipped to the customer; if the customer does not pay, the device is kept.

evidence.quote: 'Revibe Lab final decision: Valid → full refund + ship back to seller. Invalid → customer pays = ship to customer; doesn't pay = device kept'.
either the customer will pay to get back his device
will keep the device.

facts.statement: The portal info displayed for a return covers four items: Tracking (original shipment), Pickup Tracking (return), Ship-Back (sent to customer) and Lab (testing).

evidence.quote: 'Portal info displayed: Tracking (original shipment) · Pickup Tracking (return) · Ship-Back (sent to customer) · Lab (testing).'

facts.statement: All refunds and charges for returns appear in the payment tool.

evidence.quote: 'Payment: all refunds and charges appear in the payment tool.'

asr_fixes.basis: The PDF on screen spells the brand 'Revibe' in its title 'Revibe Return Process', in step 2 'Revibe Agent Check' and in 'Revibe Lab final decision'. The speech at 12:10 (and in the 12:16 sentence it completes) uses 'Revive' for the same party.

unclear.issue: The codes 'AE & ZA' and 'SA' are shown on screen but not expanded. The speech at 10:51 says 'For UAE and South Africa' and at 10:58 'For Saudi Arabia', outside this window, so the markets are named but the mapping of AE, ZA and SA to them is not stated. The market mapping is not stated as a fact.
Step 2 says the request is 'marked Completed' once validated, but the status label beside it reads 'Pending Collection'. The screen does not say which status applies after validation.

The speech for 12:10 to 12:16 is in transcript.md but outside pack-3, and only its last part falls in this window. The step notes for 12:12 are taken from screen text and from the 12:10 and 12:16 speech lines; any other explanation the trainer gave in the window is not in the pack.
